brief: Wildfires in Europe force massive evacuations as heat wave continues, while a Berlin Pride ramming attack kills one and injures many. Research highlights include platforms for hearing data management, geospatial data integration, and conversational AI usability.
news_summary: Wildfires in France and Spain have displaced over 340,000 people, with more difficult hours ahead. In Berlin, a car ramming at a Pride parade leaves one dead and 16 injured, with police investigating as possible terrorism.
papers_summary: New platforms like HearingHub and DesignSafe support multi-modal data management and visualization. Usability studies on conversational product advisors and smart glasses for creative writing explore AI integration in daily tasks.

zh.brief: 柏林同志遊行遭汽車衝撞，釀1死16傷，警方搜捕涉案人士；今年最強颱風「紅霞」登陸廣東，逾71萬人疏散；歐洲野火持續肆虐，數十萬人撤離。
zh.news_summary: 德國柏林同志驕傲遊行遭汽車衝撞，造成1死16傷，警方正全力搜捕嫌犯。同時，今年最強颱風「紅霞」登陸中國廣東，逾71萬人提前疏散，多省面臨強風暴雨。
zh.papers_summary: 本日無優先論文，但英文語境中多篇論文探討數據可視化與AI輔助工具，如HearingHub協作平台及CRAFT智慧眼鏡創作系統。
